description: Documents pour les utilisateurs de bornes électriques 2016-2021 is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Association des Utilisateurs de Bornes Electriques 2016-2021. Files and contents relating to the proper use of charging stations for electric vehicles. Charging stations for electric vehicles are of + en + used and users sometimes find themselves in difficulty to park on the location reserved for them. Coverage: Association des Utilisateurs de Bornes Electriques 2016-2021. The portal shows the English title as "Documents for users of electric terminals 2016-2021" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Association des Utilisateurs de Bornes Electriques 2016-2021. Its keywords include papillon-de-vigilance, borne-de-recharge-electrique, bornes-de-recharge-electrique, vehicules-electriques, borne-electrique, stationnements. The listing shows 3 download or service links in JPG, GOOGLE DRIVE. The listing shows 2021-12-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
